transactions.description: Purchased 50 call options with a strike price of $100 and an expiration date of 9/16/22.

Investment in llC which is acquiring eleven Marriott-branded hotels (Rogers, AR - 1, Phoenix, AZ - 1, lakeland, Fl -1, Albany, gA - 1, Andover, MA - 1, Fayetteville, NC - 1, greenville, SC - 1, Johnson City, TN - 1, Beaumont, TX - 1, Richmond, VA - 1, Vancouver, WA - 1) and nine Hilton-branded hotels (Montgomery, Al -2, Schaumberg, Il -1, Jackson, TN - 1, Allen, TX -2, Burleson, TX - 1, El Paso, TX - 1, Irving, TX - 1).
10,000 shares of Slack Technologies Inc. exchanged for 776 shares of Salesforce.com Inc. as a result of a merger, with a cash payout of $267,900.
